sources.title: Deuterium retention in pre-lithiated samples and Li–D co-deposits in the DIII-D tokamak
sources.non_claim: DIII-D deuterium-retention conditions do not establish commercial-reactor tritium recovery, net electricity or LCOE.

delta: Pre-lithiated samples retained similar deuterium across tested coating thicknesses below lithium's melting point; in-situ lithium powder injection produced substantial Li–D co-deposition. Liquid-lithium behavior remains a planned follow-up.
project_effect: Add fuel retention/recovery, cold-wall co-deposition, inventory, maintenance and availability as FUS-001 candidate variables; no plant-level impact yet.
